_comment: Tier-2: the PFEM applications are not distributable on a pip stack. Pitfall (kratos.pfem_fluid #0) says PfemFluidDynamicsApplication, DelaunayMeshingApplication, PfemSolidMechanicsApplication and PFEM2Application are not published on PyPI. Executed on Kratos 10.4.3 (pip wheels, glibc-2.31 host, fresh venv on external ext4 image). None of the four imports (ModuleNotFoundError), while the reference applications used across this catalog do — so the fixture discriminates between 'absent from this build' and 'nothing is installed'. Confirmed independently against the index: pip reports no distribution for KratosPfemFluidDynamicsApplication, KratosDelaunayMeshingApplication, KratosPfemSolidMechanicsApplication or KratosPFEM2Application at any version. The fixture imports KratosMultiphysics at module scope; with Kratos absent the import raises, the process exits non-zero and the runner records a failure, never a pass.
